name: Robert Lech
title: Senior Software Engineer
bio: I build backend platforms, developer workflows, and production systems with an emphasis on reliability, operability, and clear engineering tradeoffs.
aboutLong: I'm a Senior Software Engineer based in Toronto with around a decade of experience building backend systems, platform services, infrastructure automation, and developer productivity tooling. My background combines production engineering experience with applied mathematics. At Index Exchange, I worked on backend and platform systems with a focus on reliability, operational discipline, and practical tools that help engineering teams move with confidence.
